description.text:
We are seeking an experienced software engineer to work with our development team & US clients. You will be directly working with cross-country elite engineers in the world. Also, you will be joining the software team that is responsible for the development, design, diagnose and troubleshooting, and bug fixing software modules to improve product performance and stability.
Key Qualifications:
- Proficiency in Python is required.
- Knowledge of application architecture and design patterns is a plus.
- Experience integrating generative AI products into daily workflows is a plus.
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
- 1+ years’ working experience on software development and software integration.
- Good communication and problem solving skills
- Good English ability would be a plus
